# Find Closest Number to Zero.

@example -3 is 3 away from zero; every other number is farther away.
[7,-3,5,-6]
=> -3

@example -6 and 6 tie at distance 6, and nothing else is as near. The tie goes to 6.
[12,-6,6,-13]
=> 6

@example 0 itself is in the array, and nothing can be nearer.
[3,-1,0,1]
=> 0

# A single element.
[-100000]
=> -100000

# Every value is -10^5 (a fixed starting value such as 10^5 must not leak
# out).
[-100000,-100000,-100000]
=> -100000

# The extremes of both signs, in both orders.
[-100000,100000]
=> 100000

[100000,-100000]
=> 100000

# The nearest pair d and -d, with -d first and with d first.
[-3,8,3]
=> 3

[9,3,-3,10]
=> 3

# A tied pair that is not the nearest.
[-7,7,-2]
=> -2

# All negative: the largest. All positive: the smallest.
[-9,-4,-15]
=> -4

[9,4,15]
=> 4

# The nearest is on the other side of zero from the rest.
[50,-3,70]
=> -3

# Repeats of the nearest value.
[-2,-2,5]
=> -2

[2,-2,2,-2]
=> 2
